title: Instrument plate + two standoffs
brief: Place the 48 × 32 × 3 mm plate with two 4 mm holes at local (8,16) and (40,16). Rotate the plate 90 degrees around its source Z origin, then translate it to (32,0,0) mm. Place two annular standoffs, outer diameter 8 mm, bore diameter 4 mm, length 10 mm, along +Z on the plate top at world (16,8,3) and (16,40,3). No fasteners or fit tolerance specified.
summary: An explicit rigid CAD placement study. The plate source is the retained local-model result; standoff dimensions are specified for this study. Nominal contact is not physical fit.
